submission.justification: Selection-S2 at a 50% signal-efficiency working point gives the highest expected significance of the 3 strategies and 7 working points scanned: 4.388 sigma at 140 fb^-1, stat-only. That is 1.04 sigma above the best S3 point and 1.80 sigma above the best S1 point. The neighbouring working points are also high (S2 at 40%: 3.793; at 60%: 3.973), so the optimum is not a single-point fluke. The S2 result is 0.29 sigma above the prior 2025 value of 4.1 at the same working point. The recommendation is conditional on the background estimate. The project documents contain no background-estimation method and no systematics description, so robustness of the background cannot be verified. The significance quoted is statistical only and will fall once systematic uncertainties are included. Before any claim of discovery or exclusion, the background method must be documented and validated, and the significance re-evaluated with systematics.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible expected signal significance
requirements.evidence: S2 at 50% efficiency gives 4.388 sigma (stat-only), the highest across all strategies and working points. Next best: S2 at 60% (3.973) and S3 at 60% (3.486).
